name: Stellar Performance
author: SilentHacks
description:
Five focused optimisations for smoother ship-heavy worlds.

• Ship-grid bounds caching
• Fluid cable topology caching
• Local room rebuilding
• Single-player room query reuse
• Fixed-part mesh batching

Native simulation and visual refresh rates. Reversible settings. Room gas rounding can differ slightly.

Requires Demo 0.8.2, MelonLoader 0.7.3, SDModKit and Sandbox Menu.
